svg.title: Flower Anatomy Drag & Drop
svg.desc: Static JavaScript-free interactive SVG. Click word-bank tiles to place labels on flower-part slots; Hint, Check Answer and Reset open popup panels via anchor navigation and :target toggles.

g.text: Interactive biology lab · click a word-bank tile to label each part
arrows lead from the dashed slots to each part
Study the flower — each dashed slot has anarrow pointing to one part of the flower.
Drag a label from the word bank onto its slot(or simply click a tile to place it).
Use Hint when stuck, Check Answer to revealall parts, and Reset to clear the board.
how a seed begins — from anther to ovule
Pollen lands on the sticky stigma, grows a tube down
the style, and fertilises the ovules inside the ovary.
click or drag a tile onto a slot

text.tspan: — bright, showy parts that attract pollinators.
— green, leaf-like parts that protected the bud.
— the male parts; anthers make pollen.
— the female part in the centre.
— the swollen stem tip holding every part.

g.text: Tip: click any tile in the word bank below — its label snaps onto the matching slot.

text.tspan: — green parts that guarded the bud
— the thin stalk holding the anther
— the female organ in the centre
— the sticky tip that catches pollen
— the stem tip that holds all parts

g.text: 🌼 Perfect — every label matches its arrow. Click outside this panel to close.
This clears the label currently placed on the
flower diagram and closes all open panels.
